key_idea: With heap numbering, the binary digits of N after the leading 1 spell the root-to-node path: 0 means go left (q += p), 1 means go right (p += q).
sketch: Start at p/q = 1/1 and scan the bits of N from the second most significant down to the least significant, applying p/(p+q) for a 0 bit and (p+q)/q for a 1 bit. O(log N) per query. Use unsigned 64-bit for p and q since values can reach the 32-bit unsigned range (the alternating-bit sample gives Fibonacci numbers).
